question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a pink ball, Bob has a teal ball, Claire has a silver ball, Dave has a blue ball, Eve has a red ball, Fred has a gold ball, and Gertrude has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Eve swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Then, Fred and Claire swap balls. Then, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Alice and Fred swap balls. Then, Bob and Eve swap balls. Finally, Bob and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) pink ball
(B) teal ball
(C) silver ball
(D) blue ball
(E) red ball
(F) gold ball
(G) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (pink, teal, silver, blue, red, gold, brown).
1. Gertrude ↔ Eve: (pink, teal, silver, blue, brown, gold, red).
2. Fred ↔ Dave: (pink, teal, silver, gold, brown, blue, red).
3. Fred ↔ Claire: (pink, teal, blue, gold, brown, silver, red).
4. Fred ↔ Alice: (silver, teal, blue, gold, brown, pink, red).
5. Alice ↔ Fred: (pink, teal, blue, gold, brown, silver, red).
6. Bob ↔ Eve: (pink, brown, blue, gold, teal, silver, red).
7. Bob ↔ Dave: (pink, gold, blue, brown, teal, silver, red).
Fred has the silver ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
